label: NR7 Squeeze in a Leader, Healthy Market
about: Variant of NR7 Squeeze in a Leader (R_NR7_TREND, watch: 2008-2021 profit factor 1.22 vs 1.30 needed). Adds the two filters that usually lift continuation setups: SPY above its 200-day with healthy breadth, and a quiet-volume squeeze (volume below its 20-day average). Buy a limit near the close; target the 20-day high.

source.title: Variant of R_NR7_TREND (Toby Crabel, NR7 pattern)

label: Inside Day after a Dip in a Leader
about: Variant of Inside Day after a Dip (R_INSIDE_DAY_DIP, watch: 2008-2021 profit factor 1.28 vs 1.30 needed). Restricts the pattern to relative-strength leaders in an up sector, where pauses after a dip resolve upward more often.

label: Leader 50-Day Test, Oversold in a Bull Market
about: Variant of Leader 50-Day Average Test (R_SMA50_LEADER_TEST, watch: 53% wins on unseen data). Requires the test to come with a real short-term washout (RSI(2) under 20) and SPY above its 200-day, so the dip is bought only when the market is healthy.

source.title: Variant of R_SMA50_LEADER_TEST (50-day line tests in leaders)

label: 52-Week-High Leader Dip, Deep Washout
about: Variant of 52-Week-High Leader Dip (R_52W_LEADER_DIP, watch: average trade +0.197% vs +0.20% needed). Requires the dip to be at least one ATR below the 5-day average and RSI(2) under 5, so only the sharpest pullbacks in names near their highs are taken.

label: ETF 3-Day Lower Highs & Lows in a Bull Market
about: Variant of ETF 3-Day Lower Highs & Lows (R_ETF_3DAY_HL, watch: 2008-2021 profit factor 1.295 vs 1.30 needed). Adds a SPY-above-200-day gate and buys a little below the close, so the pattern is traded only in bull markets and at a slightly better price.

source.title: Variant of R_ETF_3DAY_HL (three lower highs and lows)
